description: Base: the current tip (E086 code 749bdce: E070 schedule, Fable tail, pinned staging). Remove the SGD-era lookahead-EMA entirely, so the net trains on its own weights throughout. Drop its buffers and its foreach kernels from build and from the step loop. Keep the floor-hold, the final 8-step EMA (0.3 lerp every 4 steps), eval on the EMA weights and the BN buffers copied from the net. Change nothing else. Decide with an untimed off-seed run on seeds 3-10 against the tip's 0.7530, plus two scored runs; read the per-trial train-time logs.
